info.title: pension-practitioner-frontend
info.description: Server-rendered GOV.UK frontend for registering, amending and deregistering Pension Scheme Practitioners (PSPs). Every page returns HTML; form posts are `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and answer with a 303 redirect (Post/Redirect/Get) or re-render the form with 400. Derived from conf/*.routes and the controllers.

mdtpSession.name: mdtp
mdtpSession.description: MDTP session cookie carrying the Government Gateway bearer token; checked by the auth service.

Redirect.description: 303 See Other. Next page in the journey, or an auth/eligibility redirect (login, IV uplift, unauthorised, agent/individual/assistant stop pages, PSP dashboard, administrator-or-practitioner chooser, 'you need to register', 'you must contact HMRC' for deceased flag, session expired).

FormErrors.description: Form failed validation; page re-rendered with error summary.

CsrfFailure.description: Missing/invalid CSRF token (Play CSRF filter; standard error template).

ServerError.description: Unhandled exception or upstream failure without a mapped redirect; internal-server-error page with `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
